about.title: About NakshatraVerse
about.body: NakshatraVerse blends classical Vedic astrology with modern AI. We calculate your birth chart using precise planetary mathematics, then use AI purely to translate that chart into a clear, readable report covering career, love, health, wealth, and more — so cosmic wisdom stays accurate and easy to understand.

items.q: Do I need an account to try NakshatraVerse?
items.a: No — you can generate a birth chart and full report as a guest. Creating a free account simply lets you save reports and revisit them later from your Dashboard.

items.q: Is my birth data kept private?
items.a: Yes. Your details are used only to generate your chart and report, and are never shared or sold.
